parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/Playlist/Tests/PlaylistTests/PlaylistAPIVersionTests.swift`. The structural similarity (Jaccard 0.73) between `PlaylistAPIVersionTests.returnsV2WhenFeatureFlagIsV2` and `PlaylistAPIVersionTests.clearingOverrideRevertsToFeatureFlag` is characteristic of test methods that exercise related but distinct behavioural scenarios — feature-flag activation versus override clearing — and their near-duplicate shape is an expected artefact of the arrange-act-assert pattern, not unintentional duplication. Merging or extracting these test methods would obscure the distinct intent of each scenario and couple unrelated test assertions.
